items.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996
items.q: I can’t blame Frank, I mean you know, he wants to put his own thing together and his own music and —

ctx.x: Yeah. Grover has brought them right back to basic and Basie. Really. And it is a gorgeous thing to hear, it’s really something to hear.
Oh yeah. Well that’s great. I can’t blame Frank, I mean you know, he wants to put his own thing together and his own music and —
He was an extension of Basie, as was Thad you know. Thad got his thing out there, and Frank should be able to get his own thing out there as well.
